newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-LEVERKUSEN THRASH FREIBURG TO GO THIRD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LEVERKUSEN THRASH FREIBURG TO GO THIRD.

text.p: Ulf Kirsten, the Bundesliga's leading scorer this season, was both hero and villain as Bayer Leverkusen thrashed Freiburg 5-3 on Sunday to move up to third place in the Bundesliga.

The former East German star set Leverkusen on the road to victory with a 24th-minute equaliser after Dieter Frey had given Freiburg an early lead. But he was also sent off early in the second half for a foul on Frey.

Freiburg, however, failed to capitalise on their numerical advantage and must have felt nothing was going to go right for them when Leverkusen goalkeeper Dirk Heinen saved an 83rd minute penalty from Dutch striker Harry Decheiver.

The result allowed Leverkusen to leapfrog over Cologne and champions Dortmund to take third place and left Freiburg firmly anchored to the bottom spot, having conceded 24 goals in their first seven games.
